title: The Shape of the Arm: Capsules for the Links, Spheres, Boxes and a Floor for the World, and the Pairs of Links That Must Not Be Asked

artifact.note: the collision model of an arm: each link a capsule (a line segment with a radius) between the origins of its frames, with the last one extended to the tool tip; the world as spheres, axis aligned boxes and a floor; the distance between a segment and a segment, a point and a box (found by a search along the segment, since the distance to a convex set is convex along a line), the signed distance of a capsule to each kind of obstacle, and of the links to each other for the pairs that do not share a joint; and the smallest of them for a set of joint angles
